name: Kaya, Spirits' Justice — fired, the target token becomes a copy of a creature card in exile
notes: Found by tests/audit.py (2026-11-17). "You may choose a creature card from among them. Until end of turn, target token you control becomes a copy of it, except it has flying." "It" was not read back, so the copy picker listed every permanent on the battlefield. Now it is read back to "a creature card from among them", the cards the trigger put into exile: the picker lists the creature cards in exile (not Lightning Bolt), and the token becomes Hill Giant with flying.

scryfallData.name: Kaya, Spirits' Justice
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Whenever one or more creatures you control and/or creature cards in your graveyard are put into exile, you may choose a creature card from among them. Until end of turn, target token you control becomes a copy of it, except it has flying.
+2: Surveil 2, then exile a card from a graveyard.
+1: Create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.
−2: Exile target creature you control. For each other player, exile up to one target creature that player controls.
